title: skillcheck agent self-critique response
description: JSON shape that skillcheck's --ingest-critique mode expects from a calling agent. Severity values use the lowercased Severity enum names (error, warning, info). Scores are integers in the inclusive 0-100 range.

clarity_score.description: How clearly the skill states what it does and when (0-100).

completeness_score.description: Whether all necessary context is present for execution (0-100).

executability_score.description: Whether an agent can act on the instructions as written (0-100).

missing_context.description: Names of things an agent would need but the skill omits.

contradictions.description: Pairs of contradicting locations within the skill body.
